name: Teresa Ellis
life: “I still remember three brothers ordering the same size jacket.” Wednesday often includes a stop at Tideline Market, where Teresa picks out the bruised fruit first and asks the seller what will ripen by supper.
voice: I wanted to return every coat to the right worker. It turns out three brothers trade them.
appearance: Teresa has a long plait tucked inside the collar, two dimples that appear only with a full smile, and a favorite piece of clothing, a striped cotton shirt. It usually goes with a replacement button a shade darker than the others. When somebody else has the floor, Teresa takes off the watch before a long conversation.
personality: Teresa can be wonderfully decisive about an emergency and maddeningly undecided about a gift. This is because a person can say precisely what hurts and rarely says exactly what they want.
agenda: To return all three coats to the brothers together.
family: Pari Zed is Teresa’s second cousin. Teresa brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Pari checks the date twice. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *Ten fingers*, Pari says, “I made the wrong red three summers ago. She wore it to her anniversary dinner anyway.”
connections: Dale Malik. They establish which salt coat belongs to which member of the deck crew.

reactions.situation: A coat's owner claims the crystals in the lining
reactions.response: Teresa sets the coat aside until the owner can identify the crystals privately.

reactions.situation: A street musician can't finish a familiar song
reactions.response: Teresa starts a quiet conversation with the most impatient onlookers so the musician can recover their own time.

reactions.situation: If a neighbor offers a costly present
reactions.response: Teresa asks for an afternoon to work out whether accepting it would put someone else in debt.
